payload.decision: FAIL / NO_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED / NO_ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS. F-TIC-FLOW-CONTRARIAN-US used 185 point-in-time first-release U.S. Treasury TIC monthly observations from 2011-01 through 2026-05 and treated negative foreign net purchases of U.S. corporate stocks as a contrarian risk-on state, with actual release date +1 availability and a 45-calendar-day stale ceiling. The candidate produced CAGR 14.433724%, Sharpe 1.516287 and MDD 8.612735%. CAGR exceeded frozen V11 and Sharpe exceeded the availability-matched unconditional retention control, but full Sharpe remained below V11 1.522263 and the candidate beat matched-control Sharpe in only 3/7 fixed folds. Paired 63-session moving-block bootstrap over 20000 replicates gave P(CAGR candidate > V11)=76.235% and P(Sharpe candidate > matched)=86.925%; both median incremental deltas were positive and candidate MDD P97.5=14.659% passed the 15% risk ceiling. Cumulative 31-trial DSR probability was 94.345%, below the frozen 95% requirement. Therefore the factor is not published as a validated/promoted factor. Per the stop rule, no sign reversal, magnitude threshold, percentile/z-score, multi-month aggregation, normalization, country decomposition, regime rescaling, stale-rule change, retention search or second retrospective TIC equity-flow factor is permitted.
